name: Rail · selected vs open (two signals) — UX-F-02: selected and open are two signals, not one. aria-selected and the accent bar are both bound to “active AND drawer open” (LeftSidebar.tsx:137-160), so with the drawer shut the rail reports a tablist with nothing chosen. The selected item stays marked whether the drawer is open or shut, and rail arrow-keys either move focus only (manual activation) or open the panel they select. Specimen still owed: 199:409 Shell state 5 · Drawer closed draws a fully neutral rail, so the file agrees with the code's bug rather than with this board.
why: UX-F-02 — the board that answers it was built 2026-09-07 and carried no finding id, so the register read PENDING while the drawing existed.

The canonical / og:url half is REFUTED and is explicitly marked not-to-be-drawn on the note, because publish-html.ts:88-97 already injects a correct per-path pair. The head-preview card is NOT drawn, and that is now a measurement rather than a guess. publish-crosssection#10 carried this arc's last unresolved selector; it resolves to 2429:12111 “Content · dynamic-pages” (280x812 @2320,220 in 1776:8376), read this pass: layoutMode=VERTICAL and contentExtent=812 of 812 — the board is FULL, so a head-preview section can only be added by hiding rows that carry other findings' content. Its three sibling states (2429:21243 no-pattern, 2429:21262 none-published, 2429:21281 no-template) are all 280x812 and equally full, as are 2850:12042 unknown-key and 2850:21351 no-records. A new board is no cheaper: section 06 · Content measures 3440x5957 with maxBottom=5927, a free strip of THIRTY pixels, and the section already computes as a pre-existing overlap against 07 · Brand — growing it makes that overlap worse. So the card wants a section re-space (order-sections.mjs), which is the arrangement lane's job and not something to start while other passes write into the same file. The contract is on 2876:12480 so nothing is lost; the geometry is recorded here so the next pass inherits the measurement.
